content.thinking: Invoices 801 and 802 share the same vendor and amount but have different dates, making them the only candidate duplicate. I'll check their payment dates for consistency and review the related GL journals.

input.sql: select i.*, h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", h."MEMO" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID" in (801,802)

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_DT", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", pr."STAT_CD" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" join "GLPERD" pr on pr."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT" or h."POST_DT"<>p."PAY_DT" limit 20

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."SRC_CD"='GL' and p."STAT_CD"='C' order by h."POST_DT" desc limit 10
select c."ACCT_CD", c."ACCT_NM", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" l join "GLCOA" c on trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") where trim(c."ACCT_CD")='2000' group by 1,2
